title: deer hunter II
description:
An archaeological survival/exploration game.

Wake up in a desert and learn to survive. Avoid exposure, snake bites and dehydration as you hunt for resources and loot corpses of those who came before you. Craft new items, discover new sights and grow stronger to take on your final challenge...Features• crafting system ⚒️

• day-night cycle 🐫

• fun combat 🏹

• about 1+ hour of gameplay 🌵

• find corpses and items of previous players 💀
ControlsWASD - walk
LMB - use
RMB - drop
E - interact
Shift - run
Control - crouch
Escape - menu

Note: on Mac OSX, rotate the camera by dragging and use items with space bar.
(Game Maker's mouse lock function doesn't work on Mac)
